veranderings.blok: Wat die kaart van jou provinsie vertel
veranderings.rede: 'Volg die lyn rond' echoes English 'follow the line around'; 'al om' is the natural Afrikaans for going all the way round.

veranderings.blok: Hoe jy dit self in die atlas doen
veranderings.na: Lees die kaart met die sleutel
veranderings.rede: Two maps are named just before, so 'dit' is vague; naming the map makes the reference clear without changing the meaning.
